templates.title: Lyftr
templates.description: Self-hosted workout, nutrition and bodyweight tracker (API + web app, SQLite)
templates.note: Generate JWT_SECRET with openssl rand -hex 32 and keep it across updates. Registration defaults to first-user here: only the first account can be created. Data lives in the lyftr-data volume. Docs: lyftr-app.pages.dev

env.name: JWT_SECRET
env.label: JWT secret
env.description: Random string of at least 32 characters that signs sign-in tokens, e.g. the output of: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it the same across updates.

env.name: HTTP_PORT
env.label: Web UI port
env.description: Host port the web app is published on.

select.text: First user only (recommended for a new install)
Open (anyone who can reach the server)

env.name: LYFTR_VERSION
env.label: Image tag
env.description: stable follows releases; a version tag such as v0.1.0-beta.9 pins one; latest follows the main branch.
